hero.name: Vladimir Koryagin
hero.subtitle: Technical Writer · professional-grade English and Russian documentation
hero.description: I make what you're building clear to everyone who needs to get it — from your engineers and users to investors and foundations. Native Russian, professional English, sharpened by years of translation and interpreting for McKinsey and others. I can write directly in English, for English-speaking audiences. I embed with an engineering team and handle product docs first, then pitchdecks, grants, UI and more.

story.heading: My Story
story.lead: Several times I've had to master an entirely new field — and each time I did. Interpreting for PepsiCo/Wimm-Bill-Dann boardrooms and McKinsey engagements, and now 3+ years of technical work in Web3. I bring real expertise today, plus a proven track record of learning fast whatever comes next.

milestones.title: Translator
milestones.description: Graduated from the Department of Romance and Germanic Languages. Started out translating technical, legal, and marketing texts between Russian and English.

bullets: Translated technical and legal documentation and marketing materials (RU ↔ EN)
Localized software from 2005
Worked with Russian and international clients across industries
Named Best Translator of 2007 by Argos Translations, an international agency
Wrote knowledge-base articles for IT clients, mainly Google (via Janus Worldwide)

milestones.title: Translator & Interpreter at Wimm-Bill-Dann & McKinsey
milestones.description: Moved to Moscow. Beyond written translation, did interpreting at board meetings, investor visits, and consulting sessions.

bullets: Simultaneous and consecutive interpreting at C-level meetings, board sessions, and investor visits
Worked on-site at Wimm-Bill-Dann during PepsiCo acquisition
Interpreted for McKinsey consulting teams in client engagements, including international trips
Delivered language training to McKinsey consulting teams and administrative staff
Accompanied executives on business trips and led production-site tours for partners and investors

milestones.title: Team Lead & Senior Translator
milestones.description: Ran a translation team for 10+ years with McKinsey as the key direct client. Translated engagement documents, compiled research reports (GOST 7.32), maintained glossaries, and moved the team onto CAT tools.

bullets: Led language support: 5–7 in-house plus 10–20 freelancers brought in for specific projects
Main client: McKinsey & Company (10+ years); other clients: Thales Group, JTI, Mars, Heineken, etc.
Managed the team's translation, proofreading, and editing workflows
Personally translated, proofread, and edited documents alongside the team
Sole owner of extensive GOST 7.32 research reports for McKinsey (up to 700 pages): compiled them from scattered sources and led the team on these projects
Maintained glossaries and style guides
Moved the team onto CAT tools (translation memories, termbases) instead of translating by hand in Word and PowerPoint
Ran QA checks and managed deadlines

milestones.title: Dev Support at PointGroup
milestones.description: Switched to tech. Working as part of a dev team at a European Web3 company. Came into Web3 from scratch and built the company's documentation — there was none before me.

bullets: Write and deploy documentation based on Docs-as-Code using an SSG engine (VitePress) or GitBook for the company's Web3 projects (JPool, Alula, Ignition, Vortum, JPool Validator Dashboard, SVT, Albus, and others)
Write and edit in-product copy: button labels, error messages, onboarding, empty states, tooltips
Handle localization: EN and RU myself; manage translation into other languages (AI draft, final edit by native speakers)
Create technical diagrams and schematics (Draw.io, Mermaid, PlantUML)

Prepare documentation and close milestones for Web3 grant projects: applications, technical write-ups and diagrams, demo videos. On grant projects I handle everything but the code; every milestone was delivered and every grant paid out (Solana, Stellar, Internet Computer, and other foundations)
Create investor materials (pitch decks, event presentations, one-pagers)
Record and publish tutorial and demo videos for products
Took a mobile app all the way to publication on Google Play (did everything but the code); prepare listings and maintain their metadata
Organize and maintain team task tracking and project data rooms in Notion
Communicate with foundations and partners

skills.heading: What I Can Do
skills.lead: Everything a dev team needs besides writing code.

items.title: Embedded into Dev Teams
items.description: I work directly with developers. Comfortable with sprints, Git workflows, and async communication. I keep up with sprint pace and tight deadlines.

items.title: Technical Documentation
items.description: I write and deploy docs with SSG engines (VitePress, Sphinx, Jekyll, etc.) or doc-hosting services like GitBook.

items.title: UX Writing & Microcopy
items.description: I write and edit the text inside your product — button labels, error messages, onboarding flows, empty states, tooltips.

items.title: Localization
items.description: I localize between English and Russian myself, and manage localization into other languages — AI-assisted drafts finalized by native-speaking reviewers.

items.title: Grant Projects
items.description: On grant projects I handle everything but the code: applications, technical write-ups and diagrams, demo videos, reports, and foundation comms. Every milestone delivered, every grant paid (Solana, Stellar, Internet Computer, and other foundations).

items.title: Investor Materials
items.description: Pitch decks, one-pagers, project blurbs, investor letters, data rooms.

items.title: Technical Diagrams
items.description: I draw architecture diagrams, flowcharts, and system overviews (including UML).

items.title: Video Production
items.description: I record and edit tutorial videos, grant demos, and product walkthroughs with motion graphics.

items.title: Blog & Social Media
items.description: I write and edit posts for company blogs, Twitter/X threads, community channels.
